item.title: New Minecraft Bedrock Addon Lets Solves Inventory Management!
item.description:
Minecraft has almost a thousand blocks… and you get 36 slots and NINE hotbar items. 😤
Bedrock Hotbar Shuffle fixes that. One keybind. Your entire inventory. No menus, no swapping, no dragging items around like a lunatic.
If you build on Bedrock, this is the addon you've been quietly rage-quitting about for years.
⚡ WHAT IT DOES Bedrock Hotbar Shuffle adds a keybindable macro that shifts your active hotbar through all 3 extra rows of your inventory — instantly. Tools stay put. Food stays put.
